name: Viejas Band of Kumeyaay Indians (United States)
description: A yellow field charged at the centre with a white disc bearing a four-quartered medicine wheel of black, red, white and teal, encircled by the words 'Sovereign Nation of the Viejas Band of Kumeyaay Indians'.
history: Flag of the Viejas Band of Kumeyaay Indians of the Viejas Reservation, San Diego County, California.

features.role: medicine wheel within an inscribed ring
